weather_report:
As night drapes its gentle shroud over Boston, the remnants of the day linger softly in the cool air. A whisper of fog dances along the streets, a fleeting visitor poised to fade before the sun fully embraces the morning. The temperature settles languidly at around 63 degrees, a serene backdrop for those who may find themselves stirring as dawn approaches. In the stillness, the west wind breathes lightly, an invitation for quiet contemplation.

As Saturday breaks, the fog will gracefully yield to the promise of clarity. Sunshine will unfurl, revealing a day tempted by warmth, inviting residents to shake off the remnants of slumber and bask in the light. The high will hover near 84 degrees, encouraging those who venture outside to revel in the gentle warmth while perhaps finding a shaded corner in a nearby park or along the Charles River. Light attire will keep you comfortable—a casual shirt and breezy shorts will suffice, perhaps complemented by a pair of comfortable shoes suited for a leisurely stroll. As the day unfolds with calm energy, it offers a perfect backdrop for subdued yet cherished activities, like sipping coffee at a neighborhood café or indulging in the simple pleasure of a book under a blooming tree.
